item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Adversarial Style Optimization: Enhancing VLM Jailbreaks by GRPO-based Stylistic Triggers Optimization
item.description: Researchers propose Adversarial Style Optimization (ASO) to exploit stylistic inconsistencies between MLLMs' comprehension and safety, enhancing visual jailbreak attacks.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] A Consensus-Based Framework for Relative Preference Evaluation of Large Language Models
item.description: Researchers propose a consensus-based LLM evaluation framework measuring relative preference among model responses using inter-model agreement as a quality proxy.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Evaluation design conditions the expert-vs-auto MeSH gap: a controlled comparison of bag-of-words and BiomedBERT on the Cohen benchmark
item.description: Evaluation design significantly impacts measured differences between expert and automatic Medical Subject Headings for document classification.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Humanly: A Configurable and Traceable Environment for Human-AI Collaborative Writing
item.description: Humanly is a writing platform that records the writing process to reveal whether documents were created through human typing, AI generation, or collaboration.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Probing Latent Colombian Identity Inferences in Qwen2.5-7B with Natural Language Autoencoders
item.description: Study examines whether Qwen2.5-7B internally represents Colombian identity and stereotypes when processing Colombian-Spanish and English text using natural language autoencoders.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Khondo: A Multimodal Benchmark for Document Packet Splitting of Bangla Forms
item.description: Khondo benchmark for Bangladeshi government form splitting shows multimodal models effectively cluster pages but struggle with shuffled page order reconstruction.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Agentic Evaluation of Copyright Law Compliance
item.description: Copyright-Bench benchmark evaluates LLM agents' copyright compliance, revealing they often select copyrighted content over available public-domain alternatives.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Data Quality over Capacity: Internalizing Documents into LoRA Adapters for Closed-Book QA
item.description: Research shows data quality, not model capacity, is the dominant factor for closed-book QA using LoRA-adapted language models.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Leveraging External Knowledge for Historical Document Restoration via Retrieval-Augmented Large Language Models
item.description: Retrieval-augmented LLM framework improves restoration of degraded historical documents, particularly for recovering named entities.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] On Improving Faithfulness of Podcasts from Documents
item.description: State-of-the-art LLMs generate ungrounded content in podcast transcripts; researchers propose catch-n-repair framework to improve faithfulness.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Ground Truth First: A Longitudinal Evaluation Instrument for Agent Memory, and the Tenure Crossover in Memory-Architecture Rankings
item.description: New ground-truth-first benchmark reveals LLM agent memory architecture rankings invert over extended histories, with graph-based systems gaining on curated maps.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] MoE$^2$-LoRA: When MoE Models Meet MoE-style Low-Rank Adaptation
item.description: MoE²-LoRA introduces parameter-efficient fine-tuning for Mixture-of-Experts models through dynamic routing and shared expert pools while maintaining general capabilities.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Analyzing Toxic Behavior and Its Impact on the Mastodon Community
item.description: Research uses machine learning to analyze toxic content on Mastodon, revealing toxicity trends in a decentralized social network lacking unified moderation standards.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] J-CoT: Chain-of-Thought in J-Space
item.description: J-CoT introduces a reasoning framework using vocabulary-indexed intermediate states instead of natural language or full hidden representations for language models.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Analysing Self-Harm Representations in Language Models: a Cross-Architecture Study
item.description: Research across four language models shows self-harm content representations concentrate in the final 3-7% of network layers with architecture-dependent patterns.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] DWT-Fusion: A Signal-Based Framework for Training-Free LLM-Generated Text Detection
item.description: Discrete wavelet analysis of token-level probabilities enables training-free LLM-generated text detection, achieving 98.72% AUROC on HC3 dataset.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Enough is as good as a feast: A Comprehensive Analysis of How Reinforcement Learning Mitigates Task Conflicts in LLMs
item.description: RL-trained LLMs degrade less when merged than SFT-trained models because RL reduces task conflicts during training.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Developing and Validating the Spanish Version of the Large Language Models Dependency Scale (LLM-D12-SP)
item.description: Researchers validated the Spanish version of an LLM dependency scale measuring instrumental and psychological reliance on large language models among 386 participants.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Scaling Native Multimodal Pre-Training From Scratch
item.description: Researchers establish scaling laws for native multimodal pre-training, showing language and multimodal objectives scale differently and data composition influences optimal model sizing.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Benchmarking Fine-tuning and Retrieval Strategies for a Multimodal Language Model on the NRC Reactor Operator Licensing Examination
item.description: Retrieval-augmented fine-tuned multimodal LLM achieves 79.7% accuracy on NRC reactor operator licensing examination benchmarks.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] FSE: Continual Learning for Named Entity Recognition by Fast-Slow Experts
item.description: FSE proposes a span-based NER model using Fast-Slow Experts to enable continual learning without catastrophic forgetting.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] MEUSLI: a Multilingual Projector for LLM-based ASR and Beyond
item.description: MEUSLI is an open-source multilingual projector connecting Whisper encoders with LLMs for ASR and speech tasks across 28 European languages.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Dynamic Commonsense Coordination for Empathetic Response Generation
item.description: Researchers propose DCC, a framework using dynamic commonsense coordination modules to improve empathetic response generation in dialogue systems.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] From Isolated Tasks to Structured Capabilities: A Multilayer Taxonomy for Large Language Models
item.description: A multi-layer taxonomy organizes LLM capabilities into 14 domains and 91 subskills, validated against 15,934 research papers.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Why Large Language Models and Humans Converge and Diverge in Evaluating Creativity
item.description: LLMs align moderately with human creativity judgments, converging on novelty but diverging on contextual information.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Biomedical Machine Translation for Low-Resource Arabic-Script Languages via Cross-Lingual Transfer and LoRA Adapter Merging
item.description: Cross-lingual transfer and LoRA adapter merging improve biomedical machine translation for low-resource Arabic-script languages with mixed results.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] A Factorial Study of Synthetic Data Generation for Low-Resource Machine Translation using Grammar Books
item.description: Researchers generate synthetic training data from grammar books using LLMs to improve machine translation for endangered languages.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] grapheme-kit: Grapheme-Level Metrics and Text Processing for Multilingual NLP
item.description: grapheme-kit, an open-source Python library, extends NLP metrics to operate on grapheme clusters instead of Unicode code points for more accurate multilingual evaluation.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] Skill Self-Play: Pushing the Frontier of LLM Capability with Co-Evolving Skills
item.description: Skill Self-Play framework co-evolves LLM capabilities through dynamic skill routing, reconciling open-ended task generation with reliable verification for improved reasoning.

item.title: [arXiv cs.CL] From Obligation to Specification: A Survey on Validating EU AI Act Requirements in RE
item.description: Survey reveals organizations lack systematic processes to translate EU AI Act obligations into verifiable requirements; LLM-based tools show promise but require safeguards.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Cloud-Native Evaluation-as-a-Service: A Microservices Architecture for Scalable AI Monitoring with Conformal Guarantees
item.description: EaaS is a cloud-native microservices reference architecture for AI evaluation with conformal prediction, drift detection, and fairness monitoring.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] On the Depth Scalability of Logic Gate Networks
item.description: Input-Anchored Logic Gate Networks solve depth-scalability limitations by anchoring each gate to direct inputs, achieving improvements beyond 100 layers on standard datasets.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] MotifRole-Diff: Risk-Optimal Role-Aware Corruption for Masked Molecular Graph Diffusion
item.description: Role-aware corruption strategies improve molecular graph generation by allocating masking rates based on token denoising difficulty rather than uniform masking.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Toward User-Conditioned Evaluation of Personal LLM Agents under Temporal Interventions
item.description: Researchers propose evaluation protocols for personal LLM agents that test how temporal interventions propagate across persistent user-conditioned states, filling benchmark gaps.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Measuring the Dependency Gap: Diagnosing Inter-Column Fidelity in Tabular Generative Models
item.description: Standard synthetic tabular data metrics fail to measure inter-column dependencies; new diagnostic reveals significant fidelity gaps in state-of-the-art generators.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Quasi-Monte Carlo Initialization for Meta-Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Quasi-Monte Carlo weight initialization improves meta-reinforcement learning convergence on similar continuous control tasks but underperforms versus orthogonal methods on dissimilar tasks.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Toward Goal-Agnostic Joint-Embedding Predictive Control of Partial Differential Equations
item.description: Goal-agnostic PDE control framework using frozen JEPA model improves performance by optimizing physical observables instead of latent-space distances.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Multi-Horizon Consistency as Geometry: When Latent Dynamics Contract, and When They Do Not
item.description: Multi-horizon consistency training contracts latent dynamics and reduces prediction error in Moving-MNIST but shows domain-limited generalization.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Adjustment Speed as a Safety Constraint for Nonstationary Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Paper proposes adaptation speed constraints for reinforcement learning safety in nonstationary environments, restricting actions when required adaptation exceeds system capacity.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] A Drift Stable Quantum Federated Learning for Intelligent Services
item.description: DUQFL-Prox, a quantum federated learning framework using deep-unfolded optimization, improves stability and fairness in distributed quantum neural network training.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Shallower ReLU Network Representations via Exact Linear Algebra
item.description: ReLU networks with two hidden layers exactly represent maximum functions for up to ten numbers, improving depth bounds for larger dimensions.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Molt: A Scalable PyTorch-Native Training Framework for Agentic Reinforcement Learning
item.description: Molt, a PyTorch-native framework for agentic reinforcement learning, simplifies algorithm research while matching state-of-the-art Megatron systems in performance.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Physically Constrained Federated Additive Models for O-RAN SLA-Risk Prediction
item.description: Physically-constrained federated additive model improves auditable SLA violation prediction for O-RAN systems.

item.title: [arXiv cs.LG] Neural Feature Governance: Extending Atom Prevalence
item.description: Neural Atom Prevalence introduces a Bayesian framework for neural network compression achieving up to 92% sparsity while maintaining uncertainty quantification.
